description: This file defines a FastAPI backend API for a personal journal application. It includes endpoints for CRUD operations on journal entries, health checks, date filtering, and image uploads. It also configures middleware, static file serving, and database initialization.

classes.name: DatesWithEntriesResponse
classes.description: Custom JSON response class for dates with journal entries.

methods.name: verify_post_sample()
methods.description: Creates a sample journal entry for verification purposes, returning the created entry.

methods.name: str _save_upload(file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Saves uploaded image files to static uploads directory, returning the public URL path.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Performs a health check to confirm the service is running.

methods.name: list_journal_entries( start_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive"), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="End date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive"), title: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Case-insensitive substring to match in the title"), )
methods.description: Lists journal entries with optional filtering by date range and title substring.

methods.name: get_dates_with_entries( start_date: date = Query(..., description="Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive"), end_date: date = Query(..., description="End date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive"), )
methods.description: Returns dates with entries within a given date range.

methods.name: get_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to fetch", ge=1) )
methods.description: Fetches a single journal entry by its ID.

methods.name: create_journal_entry( payload: Optional[JournalEntryCreate] = Body( None, description="JSON body with title and content (used when no image is provided)", examples={ "json": { "summary": "JSON create without image", "description": "Create a journal entry using JSON payload", "value": {"title": "My day", "content": "Went hiking today."}, } }, ), title: Optional[str] = Form( None, description="Title for the journal entry (1..200 chars)" ), content: Optional[str] = Form( None, description="Content/body for the entry (0..10000 chars); may be empty" ), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file",), image_remove: Optional[bool] = Form( False, description="Set true to explicitly remove an already-attached image (not typical on create).", ), )
methods.description: Creates a new journal entry, supporting JSON and multipart form data.

methods.name: update_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to update", ge=1), payload: Optional[JournalEntryUpdate] = Body( None, description="JSON body with fields to update when not uploading an image", examples={ "json-partial": { "summary": "Partial JSON update", "value": {"title": "Updated title"}, } }, ), title: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Updated title (1..200 chars)"), content: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Updated content (0..10000 chars)"), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file to replace existing"), image_remove: Optional[bool] = Form(False, description="Set true to remove existing image"), )
methods.description: Updates an existing journal entry with optional image replacement or removal. Supports JSON and multipart form data.

methods.name: delete_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to delete", ge=1) )
methods.description: Deletes a journal entry by ID.

methods.name: HTTPException _structured_500(message: str, context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
